Harbor Line Ferry - Complete Timetable and Rider Guide

The Harbor Line is operated by the Tidewater Transit Authority.

On Saturdays the last sailing from Pier 9 departs at 11:15 PM.

Rider notes for Pier 9

Rider notes for Pier 9, note 1. Boarding opens fifteen minutes before departure. Bicycles ride on the lower deck, strollers stay folded in the aft rack, and pets travel on a leash or in a carrier. Crew may hold a sailing for weather; check the notice board at the terminal.
